title: Rewrite
text: Write $$sin^5\left(x\right)$$ as $$\left(1-cos^2\left(x\right)\right)^2 sin\left(x\right)$$ and let $$u=cos(x)$$, so $$du=-sin\left(x\right) dx$$.

title: Integrate
text: The integral becomes the integral of $$-\left(u^2-2u^4+u^6\right)$$, which is $$\frac{-u^3}{3}+\frac{2u^5}{5}-\frac{u^7}{7}$$.
